acceptanceCases.case: THE INDEPENDENT DENOMINATOR (the prevention guard), WITH THE DISJOINTNESS ARM. (i) A walk of the WHOLE settlement blob over the 63-row structured sample reports the path shape of every string exactly equal to a roster institution name, and EVERY shape must appear in INSTITUTION_RENAME_SURFACES or in NON_CASCADED_SURFACES. It never reads the module's own declarations — a probe map naming the same paths is a self-referential exam (the R-5 defect tests/domain/factionRename.test.js was rebuilt to remove, which had reported a confident green over four reader-visible surfaces that never moved). THE STRIDE AND ITS WALL-CLOCK, MEASURED: 63 rows (one per settType × terrainOverride pair plus the 21 non-grid rows — the sample the census recon proved reproduces the full 525-row classification exactly), 1,223 ms for 63 generations, 2,428 institutions, all six tiers. ANTI-VACUITY FIRST: >=40 distinct shapes (measured 42) and >=2,000 institutions, so an empty green cannot be mistaken for a clean one. A NEW stored field that starts holding an institution name reds this arm instead of hiding behind an un-probed path. (ii) THE DISJOINTNESS ARM (the chair's R3 ii): no secondaryAffiliation value may be BOTH a roster institution name and a roster faction name. Measured over the FULL 525-row corpus: 1,828 values = 708 institution-only + 658 faction-only + 462 neither + ZERO both. This path is cascaded by TWO writers (the faction cascade already owns it), which is lawful only while their match sets are measured disjoint — so the day one value is both, this arm reds and the chair rules it rather than one cascade silently rewriting the other's link. Its own anti-vacuity floor: >=1,000 values and >=1 of each single-class kind.

THE RENAME IS TOTAL ON REAL PIPELINE DATA — the packet's central claim, executed. For each row of the stride, on a RELOADED save, rename the institution carrying the most cascade-row handles. Measured over 525 rows: 4,227 handles before; ZERO still spelling the old name on ANY of the 38 declared rows; ZERO new dangling joins. The only residue is on the five declared NON_CASCADED paths (528 occurrences: downstreamEffects[].target 468, resourceConditions[].label 48, activeChains[].resource 12), every one accounted for by name. GUARD-THE-GUARD: assert handlesBefore > 0 and changed === true BEFORE the staleness assertion, so the arm cannot pass on a fixture holding no handles. The defect this replaces is captured at §8 step 1 BEFORE the fix exists: today the same rename leaves every one of those handles stale and nothing throws and nothing is logged.

THE MEMBER MIRROR — proved by a CONTROL PAIR rather than asserted. Joined PER PERSON by the NPC's own id, on a reloaded save: (i) the baseline — 572 paired people, ZERO disagreeing before any edit; (ii) THE NEGATIVE CONTROL — a one-home walk (npcs[] only) leaves a disagreeing person in 44 of 63 rows; (iii) the cascade's two-home walk leaves 0 of 63. The control is required, not optional: without it 'both homes agree' is also true of a fixture where neither moved. THE JOIN MUST BE PER PERSON: factions[].members[] is a strict SUBSET of npcs[] (39 npc-only people, 0 member-only), so comparing the two lists wholesale reports a false 30/63 disagreement before any edit at all. AND THE COMPOSITION THIS PROVES: design §22.2 item 7 classes the member list as a MIRROR that is RECOMPUTED after a merge — but §22.1 ruling 7 rules that a rename never goes through re-derivation, so no recompute runs for a rename and the cascade itself is the only thing that can heal the chip. Writing both homes makes any later recompute a no-op rather than a second answer.

THE REMOVAL SWEEPS THE SAME LIST — the DELTA-BY-KIND gate. Removing the worst-case institution adds ZERO new dangling joins OF ANY KIND, measured against the record's OWN pre-existing baseline and never as an absolute (design §22.1 correction 6). The baseline is real and large: over 525 rows the pre-existing strict dangles per settlement run thorp median 11, hamlet 11, village 8, town 15, city 23, metropolis 18, concentrated in five paths (resourceChains processingInstitutions 2,885; activeChains processingInstitutions 2,525; exploitation fullyExploited 869 and partiallyExploited 699; availableServices.criminal[].institution 421) — an ABSOLUTE gate reds on arrival. THE DANGLE DENOMINATOR EXCLUDES R3's THREE ROWS BY CONSTRUCTION: landmarks[], secondaryAffiliation and activeChains[].label lawfully hold non-institution strings, so counting their non-matches as dangles would be a category error. ALL FIVE removal kinds (DROP THE RECORD, DROP THE ENTRY, DROP THE ITEM, DELETE THE KEY, DELETE THE dependency OBJECT) must be observed firing — measured, all five — or the arm is vacuous on a fixture whose institution carries only one kind of handle.

THE ORPHAN REPORT IS A REPORT, NOT A REFUSAL — AND IT HAS TWO KINDS (the chair's R6). (i) A chain whose LAST processor is the removed house is reported as { kind: 'chain-lost-its-last-processor', path, chainId } — measured 304 over 525 removals. (ii) A chain whose label names the removed house is reported as { kind: 'chain-label-names-a-removed-house', path, chainId } AND THE LABEL IS NOT DELETED — the label is present on 6,676 of 6,676 chains, so deleting it would mint a shape no generated record carries — measured 7 over 525 removals, 4 of them on a chain that KEPT other processors, so the stale label is a real reader-visible fact and not merely a consequence of the chain emptying. THE SWEEP COMPLETES IN BOTH CASES: EM-PREAMBLE §P8 makes 'a guard would refuse rather than offer proceed' a STOP and design §2.7 makes guards suggestive, so a refusal inside this writer would break the preamble the packet is signed under. Whether the DM is warned, offered a fulfilment or allowed to proceed is the guard engine's judgment (EM-C2), and recordInvariants (EM-R0b) is the gate design §22.3 item 10 names. Asserted with its negative: the sweep's `changed` is still true and no path is left half-swept. OrphanKind is a CLOSED VOCABULARY OF TWO; both literals are absent from src/ and tests/ at the tip.

WHAT IT MUST NOT TOUCH. A sibling institution keeps its name. Every declared NON_CASCADED path is BYTE-IDENTICAL before and after, asserted by name — the two receipts especially (simulationTrace[].downstreamEffects[].target, which is the ruling simulationTrace[].causes[].reason already carries, and generationCoherenceReceipt.repairs[].subject, which design §22.3 item 1 classes as HISTORY by path: never merged, never recomputed, THE PROMISE). NO RECORD GAINS A KEY IT DID NOT CARRY (deep key-set equality on every touched record — the cascade never mints a spelling and never mints a parent). AND THE CHAIN LABEL SURVIVES A REMOVAL (row 38's report-only rule) — the one place in this packet where doing nothing is the contract, asserted directly rather than left to the absence of an assertion. A no-op rename (oldName === newName, an unknown name, an empty name) reports changed: false, touched: [] and mutates nothing. Every negative carries `// anchored:` on the line immediately above.

THE IMMUTABLE FORMS. institutionRenameChanges and institutionRemovalChanges return ONLY the touched top-level buckets, deep-cloned and ready to spread; they never mutate their input (deep-equal against a pre-call clone, plus not.toBe on every returned bucket); they carry the SAME touched set as the in-place forms on the same fixture; and the removal form carries the SAME orphaned notes. This is the factionRenameChanges contract and the library lane's shape: a rename must never deep-copy the whole settlement.

GOLDEN POSTURE UNCHANGED. tests/property/generatorGoldenMaster.test.js and tests/property/dossierProseManifest.test.js are bytewise unchanged, asserted as the fixture digests before and at the tip.
